title: BACK↔FE-001: Dashboard REST/gRPC API + WebSocket Stream + Auth
description: Backend provides REST/gRPC APIs, WebSocket real-time streams, and OAuth/JWT authentication to the Frontend; Frontend states its API/data and real-time streaming needs. Grounded in BACKEND_CLOUD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3 (Frontend/Dashboard Engineer).

endpoints.description: REST/gRPC endpoints exposed to the dashboard.

path.description: Endpoint path or gRPC method name.

method.description: HTTP method or gRPC call style.

response_schema_ref.description: Reference to the response payload schema.

websocket_streams.description: Real-time streams (e.g., MQTT-over-WebSocket) for live telemetry/alerts.

performance_targets.description: Latency targets (traceable to PERF-3: cloud API ≤ 200 ms P99).

api_p99_latency_ms.description: P99 API latency in ms; ceiling 200 ms per PERF-3.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine API/data contract interpretation (agent-autonomous). Breaking API changes (removed/renamed fields, auth-scheme change) escalate to Tier-2 ADR + CCR + version bump.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (API-contract alignment at planning; API/WebSocket integration during development); periodic performance review
confirm_conditions: every endpoint declares protocol, method, and auth_required
auth.scheme is a recognized enum value
reject_conditions: endpoint removed/renamed or response schema field dropped without a MAJOR version bump + CCR
auth_required = false on an endpoint exposing fleet/device data (security regression — ESC-SEC)
api_p99_latency_ms > 200 ms target asserted as acceptable without an ADR
counter_conditions: Frontend requests a field not in any response_schema_ref — request an additive (MINOR) API extension
stream event_type semantics ambiguous — request alert-semantics clarification
